newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SWIMMING-KOVACS SETS EUROPEAN 200 BREASTSTROKE RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-KOVACS SETS EUROPEAN 200 BREASTSTROKE RECORD.

text.p: Agnes Kovacs of Hungary broke her own European 200 metres breaststroke long-course record with a time of two minutes 25.31 seconds at a swimming gala on Wednesday, the organisers said.
The Hungarian Swimming Federation said Kovacs had improved on the 2:26.57 she set at the Atlanta Olympics on July 23 last year when she claimed the bronze medal.
She raced against one other swimmer, Ukrainian Svitlana Bondarenko, at the CIB International Swimming Gala in Budapest's 50-metre Komjadi Pool.
